subject.title: fix(extensions): bound extension source read with size cap

question: Should a symlinked extension source retain the previous native-import eligibility, or should safe-file policy intentionally route every symlinked extension through Jiti?
rationale: The patch deliberately adopts a helper that rejects symlinks, so this is an observable compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical safety fix.

options.title: Preserve symlink behavior
options.body: Use a bounded source-read path that preserves the prior symlink-following behavior, and add a symlink regression test alongside the oversized-file test.

options.title: Adopt Jiti fallback for symlinks
options.body: Approve symlink rejection as the new extension-loader contract and add focused proof that linked extensions remain supported through Jiti.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink behavior
recommendation.body: Use a bounded source-read path that preserves the prior symlink-following behavior, and add a symlink regression test alongside the oversized-file test.
